#!/bin/bash
# importar_celdas.sh - importa las 25 celdas FONDEO al SQX headless (5051) UNA A UNA,
# esperando a que cada una aterrice antes de enviar la siguiente (SQX descarta importaciones
# lanzadas mientras otra del mismo simbolo esta en curso; medido 2026-09-03).
CLI="http://127.0.0.1:5051/call"
DIR=/opt/SQX-headless/import
LOG=$DIR/importar_celdas.log
declare -A MAP=( [MES]=USA500IDXUSD [MNQ]=USATECHIDXUSD [MYM]=USA30IDXUSD [MGC]=XAUUSD [MCL]=LIGHTCMDUSD )
lista() { curl -s -m 60 "$CLI?cmd=-symbol%20action=list"; }
fila() { lista | grep "^$1,$1,$2,"; }
echo "inicio $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) UTC" >> "$LOG"
for S in MES MNQ MYM MGC MCL; do
  for TF in M1 M5 M15 H1 H4; do
    if [ -n "$(fila $S $TF)" ]; then echo "YA ESTABA $S $TF: $(fila $S $TF)" >> "$LOG"; continue; fi
    F="$DIR/${MAP[$S]}_$TF.csv"
    if [ ! -f "$F" ]; then echo "FALLO $S $TF: no existe $F" >> "$LOG"; continue; fi
    CMD="-data action=import symbol=$S instrument=$S filepath=$F timeframe=$TF format=Generic bar format (comma delimited) timezone=Etc/UTC"
    echo "--- $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) importando $S $TF ($(stat -c %s "$F") bytes)" >> "$LOG"
    R=$(curl -s -m 120 "$CLI?cmd=${CMD// /%20}")
    echo "    respuesta: ${R:0:200}" >> "$LOG"
    ok=0
    for i in $(seq 1 120); do
      sleep 5
      A="$(fila $S $TF)"
      if [ -n "$A" ]; then
        sleep 5
        B="$(fila $S $TF)"
        if [ "$A" = "$B" ]; then echo "OK $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) $S $TF: $B" >> "$LOG"; ok=1; break; fi
      fi
    done
    [ $ok -eq 0 ] && echo "FALLO $S $TF: no aterrizo en 10 min" >> "$LOG"
  done
done
echo "=== RESUMEN $(date -u +%H:%M:%S) UTC ===" >> "$LOG"
lista | grep -E "^(MES|MNQ|MYM|MGC|MCL)," | sort >> "$LOG"
echo "total celdas micro: $(lista | grep -cE '^(MES|MNQ|MYM|MGC|MCL),')" >> "$LOG"
echo "fin" >> "$LOG"
interpretation: Importer maps MES/MNQ/MYM/MGC/MCL to substitute markets. M6E source not established by this importer. No actual futures provenance demonstrated by symbol labels.
